summary: Use the admitted proposal timestamp for a declarative mission revision that begins draining.

replay.detail: Replay algorithms and claim ordering are unchanged. This patch does not replay or repair existing rows.

schema.detail: No table, index, database version, claim vocabulary, serialized request or digest row-encoding change.

rules.detail: Admission/checkpoint rules and their version are unchanged; no version reservation is made.

compatibility.detail: New declarative draining writes store the actual proposal acceptance time instead of the local planning clock. Their persisted run dates and cached digests therefore change. In a mixed fleet an old origin can still write a different date from a fixed origin for this path. Existing differing rows stay differing; this is not incident convergence.

downtime.detail: The separately reviewed rollout and bounded persisted-state repair have not been qualified; no operational downtime claim is made.

manual.detail: Installations with existing rows written by the previous declarative draining path are not repaired by this change. All affected members must run the qualified fixed build before any separately reviewed, bounded repair of exact affected roots. Record actual installed markers and matched-envelope/per-table postconditions. Heal remains disabled under #2648 and is not the repair route.

recovery.detail: Claim authority is preserved; this patch supplies no data conversion or repair. Rolling back can reintroduce the old origin timestamp write. Revalidate row/cache and mixed-build state; do not replay, reset digests or alter checkpoint history without a separate approved bounded plan.
